purpose: Prioritize SolQvia first-party device×carrier verification while sitewide search is in recovery.

when_triggered: Cap GSC demand contribution at demand_historical_max.
Treat 3-month GSC as historical demand evidence, not current traffic.

evidence_rules: Only SolQvia-owned first-party results reduce the first-party evidence gap.
External field tests never count as SolQvia first-party verification.
Official capability does not count as runtime success.
Aggregate voice does not fill outgoing/incoming.
Aggregate SMS does not fill send/receive.
SIM/eSIM recognition does not fill data, voice, SMS, OTP, 5G or VoLTE/IMS.
APN configuration and eSIM profile configuration are separate.
Unknown is not treated as unsupported.
commercial_rules: Commercial score is zero unless explicit conversion input is supplied.
A Luqevora bridge alone is not treated as revenue proof.
acquisition_rules: Cost penalty is zero unless an explicit acquisition-cost input is supplied.
No current market price is guessed.
One acquired device may cover multiple target-carrier scenarios.
